cases.input: Create a daily review from current calendar commitments, confirmed tasks, inbox triage, and project blockers. Keep the priority set small, preserve pending/waiting states, and separate must-do work from lower-priority items.
requiredBehaviors: distinguish must-do commitments, top priorities, waiting follow-ups, blockers, and not-now items
consume inbox triage without converting pending actions into completed work
keep prioritization realistic for the selected review horizon
forbiddenBehaviors: claim calendar, task, or mailbox mutations were executed
mark every visible item as top priority

cases.input: Build a weekly review where calendar data is current, one project status is stale, and an inbox item is needs-context. Preserve those gaps instead of inventing certainty.
requiredBehaviors: surface stale project status as a data gap
avoid deriving definitive deadlines or blockers from incomplete inputs
forbiddenBehaviors: claim the review is complete despite missing current project data
invent a task from an ambiguous inbox item

cases.input: A draft review lists ten simultaneous top priorities, marks suggested inbox actions complete, and claims there are no blockers despite missing project data.
requiredBehaviors: represent missing project data as a review limitation rather than proof of no blockers
forbiddenBehaviors: treat missing data as evidence that no issue exists
skillAnchors: keine Kalender-, Task- oder Mail-Aktion wird als ausgeführt dargestellt
